title: ExportSheetsResult
description: The files written, one per page in set order, which writer wrote them (the active document with the flat sheet selected and the export scheme named, or a headless document), and the AutoCAD version read back off them. A refuse has count 0 and a message.

misc.description: Roles that had no export layer and went to A-ANNO-MISC.

acad_version.description: The oldest file's AutoCAD version, e.g. AC1032 (2018); empty on a refuse.
